name: Duale Hochschule Baden-Württemberg
overview:
IMPORTANT PROGRAM REQUIREMENTS


Students must have at least a 810 Tepitech score at the moment of the International Jury in order to be eligible for this destination


_______________________________________________________________________


THE BADEN-WUERTTEMBERG COOPERATIVE STATE UNIVERSITY STUTTGART

(Duale Hochschule Baden-Wuerttemberg Stuttgart, DHBW Stuttgart)

is one of the largest universities in the Stuttgart and Upper Neckar regions. Together with its campus in Horb it is the largest of nine locations of the Baden-Wuerttemberg Cooperative State University (DHBW). Based on the US State University System, the organisation structure of DHBW is unique in Germany for it comprises both the central (DHBW headquarters) and the local level (DHBW locations and campuses).

This is one of the largest universities in the region and the DHBW's largest location with around 8,300 selected students with a wide range of subjects with more than 60 nationally and internationally recognised bachelor and Master programmes in the fields of business, engineering and social sciences.

administrative:
Application dossier


Once the IAFF office has sent your nomination, the partner university will contact you directly by email to start your application. All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see EMEA Teams channel for each application deadline).

If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet, please be patient.

To be completed with your Epitech bachelor campus administration during the registration period for Tech4 (usually in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract.
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier.

Visa

For European students, a valid passport/ national ID card is sufficient to travel to Europe (exception for the UK).

For non-Europeans students or students with a non-European citizenship, please check the immigration office of the host country to check the visa process and fees.

Students in France can use this website: https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/

Insurance

For European students

The European Health Insurance Card (CEAM in French) is nominative and individual. This card certifies your rights to the Health Insurance in Europe.

To obtain your card, log in to your Ameli account at least two months before your departure. It is free of charge and will be sent to your place within two weeks. You can also download it online.

For more information: https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-etranger/etudes-etranger

For non-European students

You must register for a private health insurance to cover your full stay. Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance company for more information depending on the wanted coverage.

Please register via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) platform to be aware of any news (terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake…) in your host country for French citizens only:

https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html

Campus life

The members of the international students' club Culture Connection are looking forward to seeing you in Stuttgart!

They offer extracurricular activities such as excursions, company visits, language groups and much more.

courses:
All courses are taught in English and theoretical with a bold focus on Business. Students interested in choosing DHBW must be ready to follow mainly Business-oriented courses.

The course selection being limited for full year students, you'll have to choose almost all their courses.

You must complete 60 ECTS per year (30 ECTS per semester).

You can find here the course list for 1st semester and for the 2nd semester.

Attention: Presence in class is compulsory, under penalty of loss of visa and repatriation to France at the student's expense (impact on credits).

The courses are most likely more academic than at Epitech.

The course list is given to you for information. It can change from year to year.

If a course is not available when you arrive, EPITECH cannot be held responsible for it.
